questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Kotlin?
questions.explanation: In Kotlin, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: A variable declared inside a function is...
options: local — visible only within that function
questions.correctAnswer: local — visible only within that function
questions.explanation: Function bodies create their own scope.

questions.question: True or False: A function can read a global variable in most languages.
Fill in the blank: def f() { let temp = 1 }  // temp is ___ scoped
questions.explanation: Names inside functions default to local scope.

questions.question: In Kotlin, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
